description: This file contains service functions for managing evaluations, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and checking evaluation status within a machine learning or AI evaluation system. It interacts with database entities, external components, and evaluation runners.

methods.name: runAgain
methods.description: Re-runs an evaluation by its ID, preparing evaluation data and invoking createEvaluation.

methods.name: createEvaluation
methods.description: Creates a new evaluation, saves it to the database, and initiates evaluation runs, handling evaluation results and updating status.

methods.name: getAllEvaluations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of evaluations with pagination, grouped by evaluation name, including latest run info.

methods.name: deleteEvaluation
methods.description: Deletes an evaluation and its associated evaluation runs by ID.

methods.name: isOutdated
methods.description: Checks if an evaluation is outdated based on dataset and chatflow updates.

methods.name: getEvaluation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific evaluation, including version history.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Fetches all versions of an evaluation based on its name.

methods.name: patchDeleteEvaluations
methods.description: Deletes multiple evaluations and optionally all their versions.
